categories.main_business_segments: And Do Holdings operates six main business segments: Franchise (real estate franchise network), House Leaseback (sale and leaseback of residential properties), Financial (reverse mortgage guarantees and real estate-backed loans), Real Estate Sales (purchase, redevelopment, and sale of new and used properties), Real Estate Brokerage (brokerage services for property transactions), and Renovation (home renovation and maintenance services).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary IT systems (DO NETWORK), web platforms, and e-learning for franchise operations, and applies standardized home inspection and seismic diagnostics in renovations. It utilizes a unique sale-and-leaseback model for the House Leaseback business and employs advanced property assessment and risk management techniques for reverse mortgage guarantees. Most construction and renovation work is outsourced to vetted external contractors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individual homeowners (especially seniors), small and medium-sized real estate businesses (franchisees), financial institutions (for reverse mortgage guarantees), and general consumers seeking to buy, sell, or renovate homes. The company also serves corporate clients for real estate-backed financing and targets both urban and regional markets across Japan.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are nationwide in Japan, with a network of 725 franchise stores and 28 directly operated stores as of June 2025. The company has a growing presence in metropolitan areas, especially the Kanto (Tokyo), Chubu, and Kansai regions, and has initiated overseas expansion in Thailand through a franchise model.
categories.supply_chain_position: And Do Holdings operates primarily at the midstream and downstream stages of the real estate value chain, acting as a service integrator between property owners, buyers, and financial institutions. It provides end-to-end solutions from property acquisition and renovation to sales, leasing, and financial services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on expanding the franchise network, strengthening the House Leaseback and reverse mortgage guarantee businesses, and enhancing brand recognition, particularly in the Tokyo metropolitan area. The company emphasizes digital transformation, IT system development, and human resource training, while collaborating with Dai-ichi Life Holdings to develop new real estate-financial solutions. There is no significant traditional R&D expenditure.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through franchise fees and royalties, property sales (including new, used, and redeveloped properties), leaseback rental income, brokerage commissions, renovation contracts, and financial service fees (including guarantee fees and loan interest). The company also earns capital gains from property sales and recurring income from franchise and leaseback operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include large real estate brokerages, homebuilders, and financial institutions entering the real estate network space. And Do Holdings differentiates itself through its integrated 'real estate x finance x IT' model and nationwide franchise network, but faces competition from firms with greater capital, brand power, and scale. The company is positioned as a leading innovator in the Japanese real estate franchise and leaseback markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending June 2025, consolidated revenue was 64.7 billion yen, with operating profit of 2.6 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 2.34 billion yen. The company has over 660 employees and maintains a stable, though recently slightly declining, revenue base after rapid growth in prior years. The balance sheet shows total assets of 72 billion yen and a solid equity ratio of 25.6%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: And Do Holdings offers a unique value proposition by providing one-stop, transparent, and accessible real estate services, combining property transactions, financing, and renovation under the 'House Do' brand. Its franchise system enables small businesses and new entrants to access advanced IT, training, and marketing, while its leaseback and reverse mortgage products address the needs of seniors and asset-rich, cash-poor customers. The company emphasizes trust, convenience, and comprehensive support as key differentiators.
